description: Retrieves one of CSFD's charts of movies or TV series: the best or worst rated, the most favourite or the most controversial. Returns the places in order with ID, title, year, rating, genres, countries, directors and actors. Without a limit it returns the first page, places 1–99, in one request to CSFD; each further hundred costs another request.

category.description: best or worst rated; favorite ranks by fans and has no rating; controversial ranks the most divided ratings

limit.description: How many places from the top (default 99, max 1000)

name: get_chart

colorRating.description: Overall rating as a color: good, average, bad or unknown

fans.description: Only in the favorite chart: people who count it among their favourites

rating.description: Average rating in percent, to one decimal; null in the favorite chart

title: Get Chart
